title: Revocation under restart, update and live connections
expected: Long TCP and UDP flows die on revocation. Apply, agent SIGKILL, NetBird restart, node reboot and an updater switch never open an allow-all window. established/related does not bypass revocation. Forwarding stays off until a valid policy is held (§19 AT13, ISO02, ENT02, SEC01).
actual: PUT publication 422 NODE_NOT_SERVICEABLE failed_checks=["provisioning_state=applying (want ready)","safety_status=failed"] reboot and updater were not run
commands: FVPN_E2E=1 FVPN_E2E_PREFIX=w4-isolation FVPN_E2E_PORT_BASE=36000 go test -tags e2e -count=1 -timeout 25m -p 1 -parallel 1 ./tests/e2e/at/isolation
